title: Natural external Cech cup on pure factor homology generators
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ morphisms of quasi-compact schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals, and $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Write $T$ and $P$ for the tensor and product scalar Cech functors extended to integer degrees by zero [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-left-cech-exact], and $A_F,B_G,C_{F,G}$ for the fixed scalar models of $F,G$ and the external coefficient [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model]. There is a natural transformation $\theta:T\Rightarrow P$ on all left coefficient modules. For every quasi-coherent $F$ and $n\in\mathbb N$, put $I_n=\{(p,q)\in\mathbb N^2:p+q=n\}$. There exist a $k$-linear equivalence $e:\bigoplus_{(p,q)\in I_n}H^p(A_F)\otimes_k H^q(B_G)\cong H^n(T(F))$ and an isomorphism $b:H^n(P(F))\cong H^n(C_{F,G})$. For every $(p,q)\in I_n$ and $x\in H^p(A_F),y\in H^q(B_G)$, applying $e$ to the summand inclusion of $x\otimes y$, then $H^n(\theta_F)$, then $b$, then the canonical model-to-scalar-cohomology equivalence, gives $\operatorname{externalCup}(\epsilon_F(x),\epsilon_G(y))$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], with the degree transported along $p+q=n$. No map from the scalar tensor total and no comparison to such a map occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Construct theta with explicit front/back cochain coordinates, naturally in every left module, using picardLeftCechCup_exists.
For quasi-coherent F use picardLeftCechCup_homology on this cochain-specified theta to obtain comparison isomorphisms a,b and scalar tensor-cycle normalization.

Apply tensor_kunneth_nat to the fixed scalar models A,B, which vanish in negative degrees. Compose its direct-sum equivalence with a_n^{-1} to obtain e. Lift arbitrary factor homology classes x,y to cycles using the surjectivity of homology projections. The Kunneth cycle formula gives a total cycle z representing their pure tensor. Its equality e0(lofi(x tensor y))=[z] rewrites the desired expression to the normalized value of a_n^{-1};H(theta_F);b_n on [z]. Apply the normalization from the second step to finish, including the degree cast.

theorem picardExternalCup_left_cech_generators
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ∃ θ : picardLeftTensorCechFunctor f g G ⟶ picardLeftProductCechFunctor f g G,
      ∀ (F : X.Modules) (_ : F.IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℕ),
        ∃ (e : (⨁ i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n},
              (picardScalarModel f F).homology (i.val.1 : ℤ) ⊗[k]
                (picardScalarModel g G).homology (i.val.2 : ℤ)) ≃ₗ[k]
              ((picardLeftTensorCechFunctor f g G).obj F).homology (n : ℤ))
          (b : ((picardLeftProductCechFunctor f g G).obj F).homology (n : ℤ) ≅
            (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
              (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).homology (n : ℤ)),
          ∀ (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
            (x : (picardScalarModel f F).homology (i.val.1 : ℤ))
            (y : (picardScalarModel g G).homology (i.val.2 : ℤ)),
            picardScalarModelEquiv (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n
              (b.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (θ.app F) (n : ℤ)
                (e (DirectSum.lof k _ _ i (x ⊗ₜ[k] y))))) =
              cast (congrArg (fun d ↦ ↥(scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) d)) i.property)
                (externalCup f g F G i.val.1 i.val.2
                  (picardScalarModelEquiv f F i.val.1 x)
                  (picardScalarModelEquiv g G i.val.2 y))
